description: Utility functions for detecting user agent types and platforms in a Mattermost web application, including browser, OS, and app detection.

methods.name: userAgent
methods.description: Returns the user agent string from the browser's navigator object.

methods.name: isChrome
methods.description: Checks if the user agent indicates Google Chrome browser (excluding Edge).

methods.name: isSafari
methods.description: Checks if the user agent indicates Safari browser (excluding Chrome).

methods.name: isIosSafari
methods.description: Checks if the user agent indicates iOS Safari browser.

methods.name: isIosChrome
methods.description: Checks if the user agent indicates iOS Chrome browser.

methods.name: isIosFirefox
methods.description: Checks if the user agent indicates iOS Firefox browser.

methods.name: isIosWeb
methods.description: Checks if the user agent indicates any iOS web browser (Safari or Chrome).

methods.name: isIos
methods.description: Checks if the device is an iPhone or iPad.

methods.name: isAndroid
methods.description: Checks if the device is Android.

methods.name: isAndroidChrome
methods.description: Checks if the device is Android Chrome browser.

methods.name: isAndroidFirefox
methods.description: Checks if the device is Android Firefox browser.

methods.name: isAndroidWeb
methods.description: Checks if the device is using Android Chrome or Firefox.

methods.name: isIosClassic
methods.description: Checks if using iOS via a mobile app (not web).

methods.name: isMobileApp
methods.description: Checks if user is using the Mattermost mobile app on iOS or Android.

methods.name: isMobile
methods.description: Checks if the device is iOS or Android.

methods.name: isFirefox
methods.description: Checks if the browser is Firefox.

methods.name: isChromebook
methods.description: Checks if the device is a Chromebook.

methods.name: isInternetExplorer
methods.description: Checks if the browser is Internet Explorer.

methods.name: isEdge
methods.description: Checks if the browser is Microsoft Edge.

methods.name: isChromiumEdge
methods.description: Checks if the browser is Chromium-based Edge.

methods.name: isDesktopApp
methods.description: Checks if the app is the Mattermost desktop app (Electron).

methods.name: isWindowsApp
methods.description: Checks if the desktop app is running on Windows.

methods.name: isMacApp
methods.description: Checks if the desktop app is running on Mac.

methods.name: isWindows
methods.description: Checks if the OS is Windows.

methods.name: isMac
methods.description: Checks if the OS is Mac.

methods.name: isLinux
methods.description: Checks if the OS is Linux.

methods.name: isWindows7
methods.description: Checks if the OS is Windows 7.

methods.name: getDesktopVersion
methods.description: Retrieves the Mattermost desktop app version from the user agent string.

methods.name: isTeamsMobile
methods.description: Checks if the user agent indicates Microsoft Teams mobile app.

methods.name: isOutlookMobile
methods.description: Checks if the user agent indicates Outlook mobile app.

methods.name: isM365Mobile
methods.description: Checks if the user is using Microsoft 365 mobile apps (Teams or Outlook).
